source_binding: SHA-256 of each complete saved source; Native, camera and PipelineCapture frames must join one-to-one at 20 Hz
reference_frame: Native CARLA coordinates of the exact imported OpenDRIVE road; sidewalk road 1 lane -2, positive y 3.5 to 7.5 metres, longitudinal x 0 to 140 metres
body_method: Four observed world XY corners of the heavy vehicle; width must agree with Native map readback within 0.2 metre

metrics.name: moving_sidewalk_overlap_frames
metrics.method: moving body rectangle intersects authored sidewalk polygon

metrics.name: full_body_inside_sidewalk_frames
metrics.method: moving body rectangle wholly within authored sidewalk polygon

metrics.name: observed_body_width_m
metrics.method: Native blueprint world bounding box readback

time_uncertainty: one 50 ms frame bracket plus Native sensor synchronization; no subframe onset claim
spatial_uncertainty: world XY bounding-box geometry and imported OpenDRIVE lane bounds only; City sidewalk boundary and driveway or alley authority require separate source-bound evidence

camera_review.required_annotations: 480 frame-indexed visible flags and normalized subject boxes joined to Native and video frame IDs
camera_review.original_video_source: SHA-256 bound lossless Matroska sidewalk.mkv with manual box-review provenance
camera_review.synthetic_video_source: explicit text stub used only for CPU diagnostics
camera_review.fallback3_threshold: source-bound visible frames below 360 of 480 triggers the wider camera field
camera_review.limitation: Annotation structure and source hashes are checked; pixel truth and unobstructed body visibility require independent original-video review

spatial_context.survey_input: Source-hashed GeoJSON FeatureCollection with City boundary, sidewalk and identified driveway or alley polygons; fresh packet preparation copies exact survey and calibration bytes
spatial_context.required_packet: city-context.json bound by SHA-256 to the Native map readback and a surveyed source provenance identifier
spatial_context.coordinate_system: Explicit invertible Native-to-context affine transform with named source CRS and calibration source
spatial_context.geometry: Moving four-corner body hull intersects source sidewalk and City polygons; driveway or alley entrance polygons are inventoried by unique ID
spatial_context.metrics: 20 Hz moving sidewalk, City, entrance, and City sidewalk outside entrance intersection frame counts plus first outside frame and touched entrance IDs
spatial_context.limitation: Synthetic packets validate joins and geometry only; City and entrance authority and legal exception review remain pending

exception_evidence.required_packet: exception-evidence.json with all eight electric, wheel-design, emergency, officer or employee, and security-guard facts
exception_evidence.source_binding: Each reported fact carries a citation and SHA-256 of its authority document; the packet binds Native capture report and map readback
exception_evidence.output: Reported candidate exception pattern with pending independent review, null exception applicability and null legal verdict
exception_evidence.limitation: Reported facts and synthetic controls do not prove statutory applicability or original operator status

controlled_comparison.fixed_inputs: 480 frame and Native time IDs, heavy-vehicle blueprint, speed, longitudinal body and center trace, map readback, surveyed City and sidewalk and entrance geometry, calibration, and reported exception facts
controlled_comparison.varied_input: Lateral body placement relative to the surveyed sidewalk
controlled_comparison.metrics: Reference and contrast moving sidewalk overlap, full-body inside frames, and City sidewalk outside entrance frame counts
controlled_comparison.negative_controls: Altered longitudinal center, speed, Native frame, body longitudinal vertex, survey geometry and exception fact
controlled_comparison.limitation: Synthetic paired CPU evidence only; original Native behavior, City authority, legal applicability and accepted comparison remain unverified

legal_scope: No legal violation or statutory exception is inferred from synthetic rows or authored OpenDRIVE alone
